note: Re-judged 2026-10-14 (independent reader, after 8c1c4013f2 and 7d37dcd562). RFC 8669 Section 3.2: 'It MUST be ignored when received for other BGP AFI/SAFI combinations.' The RA33 finding (the parser refused an Originator SRGB whose length is not 2 + 6N on every family, untested off labeled unicast) is answered: message TestRFC8669SRGBAnyLengthIgnoredOffLabeledUnicast asserts RFC7606ActionNone for a 3-octet SRGB on IPv4 VPN; attribute TestParsePrefixSIDAcceptsOffFamilyLabelIndexLength asserts ParsePrefixSID accepts it, re-emits it octet-equal and renders it attribute-not-implemented-3; the pool test asserts the SRv6 extractor ignores it. ClassifyPrefixSID judges SRGB length on labeled unicast only. Single-polarity stands. Not asserted: an end-to-end relay of an SRGB off labeled unicast.
